rule:
RLHF for ETHER is offline preference learning from measured scoreboards — not PPO theatre.

TOOLS OF THE TRADE:
1. After every batch that writes artifacts/scoreboard*.json, call core.preference.record_preferences_from_scoreboard (batch_phase_e already does this).
2. strategy_stats accumulate wins/n; live_strategy_boost blends STRATEGY_TRUST prior with empirical win rate (only after n>=3).
3. retrieve() already multiplies overlap by strategy_boost — so better arms surface in few-shot automatically.
4. Never form preference pairs against infra failures (docker/ollama/timeout_infra) — that teaches the wrong lesson.
5. Observability: artifacts/strategy_stats.json + preference_summary.json + preferences_tail.jsonl must land on origin via git_push_report.
6. Validate with assert_preferences_healthy() or python -m core.preference (rlhf_tick).
7. DPO rank score helper exists for when local logprobs are available; until then strategy-level bandit is the policy update.

WHAT NOT TO DO:
- Do not full-finetune the base coder on every scoreboard.
- Do not raise max_steps as a substitute for preference learning.
- Do not store unverified PASS or infra FAIL into the preference stream.

Reality: scoreboard → pairs → boosts → retrieve ranking. That is RLHF coming to life on this host.
